## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-5: banned-word list and fk_grade threshold loaded from documented config location (not hardcoded)

## Description
Implement plugins/dso/scripts/gov_copy_postprocess/config.py with dataclass GovCopyConfig(banned_words: set[str], fk_max: int, closing_ratio: float) and load_gov_copy_config(config_path). Use configparser. Raise ConfigError when [gov_copy] block missing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=pytest --test-dir=plugins/dso/tests/scripts/
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-lint.sh
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-format-check.sh
- [ ] RED tests now pass
  Verify: pytest plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py -k load_gov_copy_config
- [ ] Config values not hardcoded in other modules
  Verify: ! grep -E '(fk_max\s*=\s*8|closing_ratio\s*=\s*0\.95)' plugins/dso/scripts/gov_copy_postprocess/readability.py plugins/dso/scripts/gov_copy_postprocess/banned.py plugins/dso/scripts/gov_copy_postprocess/voice.py plugins/dso/scripts/gov_copy_postprocess/deviations.py plugins/dso/scripts/gov_copy_postprocess/__main__.py 2>/dev/null || true

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/gov_copy_postprocess/config.py: Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
